newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet barges trade firm, cargoes steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet barges trade firm, cargoes steady.

text.p: NWE jet differentials were firm on good consumer demand, traders said.
August IPE gas oil closed down 50 cents at $167 a tonne.
Barges traded at September IPE +$17.50 fob ARA for August 4-10 delivery, around $1 firmer on steady demand.
Requirements have grown partly because of the heavier loads airlines are carrying in the holiday period. Sellers remain scarce, with some still storing product to exploit the contango.
Cargoes are notionally assessed at around August IPE +$16 cif NWE, around unchanged.
